requirements.title: AI-assisted commit messages
requirements.description: When an operator requests a commit message, the system SHOULD collect exact staged evidence, offer full or disclosed partial reusable messages and quick or direct deep read-only suggestions, and bind durable jobs to the immutable selection; when the operator queues follow-up changes, the system SHOULD capture each exact index-to-worktree selection and offer an independent quick or deep suggestion job while the current suggestion remains active, then stage the next unchanged selection only after the current commit succeeds; accepting a suggestion MUST preserve operator edits and MUST NOT stage or commit files.

validation.notes: Race-enabled domain/store/proposal suites passed 60 top-level tests. Includes no-agent collection, durable same-key admission, lost acknowledgments, cancellation races, immutable input bounds, stale selection and strict result rejection. Related snapshot/matching tests prove index versus working bytes and conservative retained subsets.
Typed Connect and fake execution-owner lifecycle tests passed with isolated Git fixtures; real repository index and history were not modified.

The final Test Genie unit phase passed after the staged-message and queue changes, including explicit start, partial accept without inference, cancellation, reconnect, staged applicability races and human edit/trailer preservation. The broader scenario certification phases were not run.
Pure projection tests cover ordered groups, exact-path commit candidates bound to snapshot digests, explicit stale/commit-pending mapping, staged-to-queued demotion and successful-commit ordering.
Mocked desktop and mobile tests prove queueing starts independent quick/deep suggestions, preserves the active suggestion, and names queued suggestions that immediate staging removes.
Fake snapshot/provider and in-memory persistence prove direct deep admission uses the original immutable collection without a shallow parent.
Workflow input packaging preserves direct deep mode and job-bound evidence identity without fabricated prior coverage.
Fake workflow result decoding accepts direct deep output only for job-bound inspected evidence and rejects unsupported claimed coverage.

validation.ref: ui/src/lib/stage-batcher.test.ts::delivers request failures to their callback and still settles
validation.notes: Mock stage mutation failure reaches the explicit stage-failed state while settlement releases the dispatch guard.

validation.ref: ui/src/lib/stage-batcher.test.ts::releases a queued dispatch as retryable when its repository batcher is disposed
validation.notes: Repository-view disposal releases in-flight dispatch ownership and preserves a retry path without duplicating late callbacks.
Fake owner result projection rejects a same-ID result whose durable idempotency key differs from the originally observed execution.
Injected short entropy source proves collection/job ID generation returns a contextual error instead of panicking the API process.
Fake snapshot/provider reads 257 distinct immutable files and confirms eligibility receipts persist beyond the former 256 receipt ceiling.

validation.ref: ui/src/features/commit-message/messageSession.test.ts::does not hold without a suggestion, after failure, or once the selection already diverged
validation.notes: A cached applicable suggestion does not claim to describe a staged selection that is missing one of its files.

validation.ref: ui/src/components/CommitPanel.test.tsx::offers explicit recovery choices when a commit outcome is unresolved
validation.notes: The commit panel offers separate operator choices for an interrupted outcome; only the selected action resolves the pending queue head.
Selected index-to-worktree snapshots bind tracked and untracked bytes without staging or mutating the Git index; reads enforce the regular-file and size bounds.

A queued selection receives its own durable job while a staged-selection job remains active; retries reconnect by request key and exact selected paths, unchanged content remains applicable across unrelated commits, and changed content becomes stale.

Transactional queue admission rejects overlapping active paths without leaving an orphan job. Queue-store tests also cover revision conflicts, ordering, replay, explicit commit-pending settlement, protected pending entries, stale-reason revision updates and retirement.
Focused UI tests pass: responsive cards share one GET/Wait observer, reconnect durable jobs, show stale status and never offer Use for inapplicable results.
A queued result fills an empty editor only after operator action and opens comparison before replacing existing human text.
Fake provider proves background settlement filters unclaimed rows before applying its bounded owner-read batch.
The workflow owner cannot bind a durable staged-message request to an execution returned under a different idempotency key.
Repeated bounded sweeps advance past dispatched executions that remain running and reach an older completed execution.
Commit approval accepts only a preview with the same repository, operation, expected revision, and subject digest.
Full CLI tests passed across all packages; typed collect/check/staged start/worktree start/status/wait/cancel and generated primitive-evidence freshness verified.

Selected browser run f263360d-9b16-4e82-9557-bd8fef239adc passed desktop and companion mobile observer cases; actual screenshots were inspected. Feature interaction is covered by component and API fixtures; no live paid model qualification was performed. AM unit/contracts run 20261022-032302-b40db304 passed; final workflow/profile hashes were read back after lifecycle activation. The latest Test Genie unit phase and requirements sync passed; broader scenario certification and live model qualification were not performed.
